name: media_import_url
description: Import an HTTPS image, video, or audio URL into Higgsfield storage and return a confirmed media_id. Use this before generate_image/generate_video when the user provides a web media URL; generation medias should receive the returned media_id, not the original URL. Max URL payload: 50 MB.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the media file to import.

type.description: Expected media type. Use auto or omit when unknown.

media_id.description: Confirmed media ID. Pass this as medias[].value in generation tools.

type.description: Imported media type inferred from content-type.

content_type.description: Content-Type returned by the remote URL.

warning.description: Non-fatal warning, e.g. imported type differed from expected type.

request_id.description: MCP server HTTP request ID for support/debugging. If present, show it to the user.

upgrade_url.description: Upgrade URL. If present, you MUST show this exact upgrade link to the user so they can upgrade to continue working.
